verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own background automation for release management. Release templates progress rollouts automatically while monitoring application health, and impact-metric safeguards can automatically pause rollouts or disable environments when thresholds are crossed. Scheduled releases and timed change requests are one-off timing actions, not recurring schedules, and all automation is limited to flag rollouts rather than general user-defined workflows. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or trigger rules beyond rollout progression, recurring schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automated progression works in practice.
